notes: Wave 2b directive execution (2026-10-30, REQ-2026-0073): proxy response-header policies (hide/pass/redirect/cookie path+domain), internal locations, merge_slashes and request-header acceptance moved from accepted-unenforced/fail-closed to executable. tests/nginx/differential-http grew 150 -> 182 cases against nginx 1.29.6. Still open after wave 2b: chunked_transfer_encoding, charset family, autoindex family, gzip refinements, HTTP/2 tuning, stream module gaps (wave 3).

Wave 2 directive execution (2026-10-30, REQ-2026-0073): redirect construction policies (absolute_redirect/port_in_redirect/server_name_in_redirect), limit_req_status/limit_conn_status, max_ranges, certificate chainFile consumption and typed TOML [[http.maps]] moved from accepted-unenforced/silent to executable. tests/nginx/differential-http grew 130 -> 150 cases against nginx 1.29.6. The three upstream proxy timeout keys became explicit accepted-unenforced diagnostics instead of silent drops. Still open in this wave: proxy response header policies, internal locations, merge_slashes, header acceptance policy (wave 2b).

Wave 1 directive execution (2026-10-30, REQ-2026-0073): nginx `map` (http), `types`/`default_type`, `gzip_static` and `gzip_vary` moved from accepted-unenforced to executable with real-nginx differential evidence. tests/nginx/differential-http grew 87 -> 130 cases (oracle recaptured from nginx 1.29.6, floor 130); the migration CLI no longer treats them as unenforced. Bounded gaps: map source is a single supported variable and evaluates once before the rewrite loop; typed TOML exposes MIME types only at http level; gzip_static does not serve orphan .gz sidecars and `gunzip` remains out of scope.

Response-semantics closure (2026-10-29, REQ-2026-0073): add_header now executes nginx semantics at http/server/location (replace-on-declare inheritance, authored order and duplicates, default status list plus `always`, bounded variable expansion, one response choke point covering static/proxy/cache/return/redirect/error/named-hop/generated responses); nginx-materialized hosts stop promoting add_header into the unconditional dedicated security fields. A directory without an index answers 403 instead of 404, and error_page also maps statuses produced by return/redirect routes. The broad differential slice grew to 87 cases (0 unexpected); two nginx generated-416 header-filter quirks are documented intentional differences (nginx runs its headers filter twice on a range-generated 416), and gzip policy on generated error pages remains a documented bounded gap because the compression layer sits outside the handler.

Release-gate repair (2026-10-29): the committed conditional-cache oracle had been captured from a CRLF working tree while the committed fixture is LF, so on a clean Linux checkout every tag/length/range asserted by tests/nginx/differential differed (103 unexpected differences, 4/50 matched). The oracle was recaptured from nginx 1.29.6 against the LF fixture, .gitattributes pins every differential fixture directory as `-text`, tests/nginx/differential/run-nginx.sh runs an unprivileged package binary by injecting its http temp paths, and tools/run-nginx-differential.mjs now pins REFERENCE_NGINX, rejects a baseline captured from another build, and rejects a fixture whose byte size no longer matches the recorded representation. The gate reports 50/50 with only allowlisted known differences. tools/run-nginx-compat-gate.mjs is the new release entrypoint (wired into _sdkwork:verify as check:nginx-compat): it discovers differential orchestrators from specs/nginx-behavioral-corpus.manifest.json and executes them with SDKWORK_REQUIRE_NGINX_EVIDENCE=1, so a gate that declines to run fails the release instead of passing silently.

Directive-level contract (2026-10-29): specs/nginx-directive-inventory.json snapshots the 744 nginx 1.29.6 OSS directives from the real ngx_command_t tables; specs/nginx-directive-support.catalog.json classifies each directive for http-core-v1 (executable / accepted-unenforced / unsupported-fail-closed / excluded) with runtime field, importer mapping, risk, migration impact/action and executable evidence; tools/check-nginx-directive-matrix.mjs (11 checks, offline, mutation-tested) binds inventory, catalog, mapping.rs, fixtures, the migration CLI and the generated docs/guides/operator/NGINX-COMPATIBILITY-MATRIX.md together. tools/import-nginx-conf.mjs no longer owns a classifier: it consumes the catalog, treats types/charset_map/map bodies as data, and never renders an accepted-but-unenforced typed TOML key.

Host-selection parity (2026-10-29, task REQ-2026-0073): nginx server_name forms now execute: exact, leading wildcard any depth (longest), trailing wildcard (longest), .suffix (claims bare + wildcard), ~ regex in authored order with nginx's real case-folding rule, then the listener default host; duplicate ownership fails closed. SNI certificate selection remains exact plus one-level wildcard, so regex/trailing-wildcard names on ssl listeners are rejected at import. Bounded named locations (location @name) execute for try_files … @name and error_page … = @name with one internal redirect, compile-time cycle rejection and nginx-faithful gate/phase behaviour. Evidence: tests/nginx/differential-host/ (39 cases against nginx 1.29.6, tools/run-nginx-differential-host.mjs).

Broad real-nginx surface evidence (2026-10-29): tests/nginx/differential-http/ compares 75 cases field by field with nginx 1.29.6 (static delivery/MIME/HEAD/multipart ranges/conditionals, rewrite/return/try_files, header emission for the covered response kinds (http/location add_header model gap tracked separately), error_page mapping, gzip negotiation, allow/deny + auth_basic, limit_req/limit_conn, proxy_pass URI splice/Host/forwarded/hop-by-hop/upstream status). It exposed and closed seven real divergences: proxy_pass non-slash URI splice, multi-range 416→multipart/byteranges, directory redirect 307→301, .js MIME, duplicate $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for, strong ETag on gzip-compressed responses, add_header on rewrite-generated redirects, spurious Retry-After on limit_req rejections, and error_page retained-status header details.

Accepted-but-unenforced awareness (2026-10-29): the typed TOML plane now reports behaviour-affecting accepted keys (TLS cipher/session/OCSP policy, proxy buffering/retry/header policy, map, autoindex, charset, MIME defaults) through server_toml::UNENFORCED_BEHAVIOR_TOML_KEYS and LoadedWebServerConfig.compatibility; `validate` prints one `compatibility:` line per occurrence and `acceptedButUnenforced=` in its summary, matching the nginx-conf import plane's per-directive diagnostics.
This catalog tracks Rust data-plane and import/render progress toward the declared http-core-v1 profile.
It is not a claim of full nginx OSS behavioral parity. Grades follow PRD-nginx-compatibility.md §2.

Deploy-only keys nginx.strict / nginx.confFile are enforced by the TOML validator (W16); they are not required on the Rust NginxConfig runtime model.
REQ-linked Nginx 1.26.2 differential fixtures are indexed by specs/nginx-behavioral-corpus.manifest.json under tests/nginx/.

Executed surface expansion (2026-08): sub_filter, limit_conn, secure_link, variable proxy_pass, proxy_pass_request_headers, and UDP stream are now runtime-executable; the unified config loader (config.source-unified-loader) is the parsing component for all three authored formats.

nginx config-language alignment (2026-08): tokenizer is ngx_conf_read_token-exact (per-type quotes, backslash escapes, mid-token #/}/${{}}, need_space); include globs match libc glob (* ? [class]) sorted, relative includes anchor at the loaded root (conf_prefix); listen defaults to port 80, first server per socket is the default server (default_server overrides, duplicates error), http2 on; enables h2; proxy_pass URI parts replace the matched prefix (targetUri), return URL is a 302, root appends the full path while alias replaces the prefix (Static stripPrefix), try_files validates the executable subset, leading-wildcard server_name matches any depth; unsupported forms (regex/trailing-wildcard server_name, named locations, =code/@named try_files with serving, unix: sockets, proxy_protocol v2, conflicting client_max_body_size) fail closed.

Stock-config expansion (2026-08): default nginx.conf tuning (server_names/types/variables hash sizes, gzip_http_version/buffers/window, charset_map, lingering_*, pool sizes, proxy_temp_*) accepted; listen OS socket parameters (backlog/so_keepalive/ipv6only/bind/deferred/fastopen/rcvbuf/sndbuf/accept_filter/setfib) accepted; upstream keepalive_timeout/requests/time accepted; proxy_ssl_verify/trusted_certificate/certificate/key/server_name materialize upstream TLS (verify off, server_name off, custom SNI names, and per-upstream conflicts fail closed; TLS material must be config-relative); set_real_ip_from/real_ip_header/real_ip_recursive materialize listener trustedProxy (conflicts fail closed); include globs expand across directory segments like libc glob.

Pass-3 alignment (2026-08): http-level `http2 on` inherits to every ssl listener (nginx 1.25.1+ form); `return` bodies with variables fail closed; accept_mutex_delay/charset_types/ssl_buffer_size accepted; the JS import tool (tools/import-nginx-conf.mjs) now tokenizes with the same ngx_conf_read_token-exact lexer and expands `include` with conf_prefix anchoring and libc-glob patterns (include expansion fixed the standalone-conf import regression).

Systematic surface test suite (2026-08): crates/sdkwork-webserver-core/tests/nginx_config_surface.rs covers every supported directive family (SURFACE matrix), every fail-closed form (server/http/stream/top-level matrices), stock nginx.conf tuning acceptance by context, full nginx.conf round trip, include expansion (files/globs/nested/cycle/missing), load_nginx_compat round trips, and merge_nginx_apps; exposed and fixed two real bugs: upstream `random two least_conn` now materializes as random-two-least-connections, and include globs keep Windows drive prefixes absolute; limit_req_status/limit_req_log_level accepted.

Test-suite expansion (2026-08): tests/nginx_parser_edge_cases.rs pins tokenizer behavior (CRLF, tabs, multi-line directives, comment placement, per-type quote closing, escape table, ${var}, error line reporting, adversarial no-panic); mapping unit tests cover every ACCEPTED_IGNORED directive with sample arguments and adversarial materialization; the parser now caps block nesting at 256 levels (fail closed instead of stack overflow).

Full-surface regression (2026-09, REQ-2026-0040): tests/nginx/full-surface/ adds a single-page behavioral regression (one fixture + one self-contained probe, 57 cases) covering routing, URI canonicalization, static semantics, proxying, load balancing, response filters, limits, TLS SNI, http2 ALPN, and stream proxying against the serving data plane. First alignment runs closed five real gaps: nginx-materialized upstreams now carry the nginx-default retry policy (proxy_next_upstream error timeout equivalent) so backup failover works; proxy_set_header inheritance follows nginx replace-on-declare semantics; rewrite-changed URIs are forwarded upstream in rewritten form; If-None-Match uses RFC 9110 weak comparison with correct polarity; try_files SPA fallbacks accept nested internal-redirect targets. Cataloged remaining context gaps: server/location-level gzip granularity and server-level return.

Context completion (2026-09, REQ-2026-0041): the regression grew to 61 cases and closed the round-1 context gaps plus the PRD-required error-page mapping. Server-level gzip/gzip_types/gzip_min_length materialize into VirtualHostConfig.compression with nginx inheritance (on/off inherits http level, types/minLength replace) and the compression layer resolves the policy per matched host via a response extension. Server-level rewrite prepends to every route of its host (nginx rewrite-phase order). Server-level return collapses the host to one catch-all respond/redirect route. error_page http/server mappings materialize into VirtualHostConfig.errorPages and generated static errors (including ACL 403) internally redirect to the mapped target with optional =code status replacement, one hop, static targets. Still cataloged: location-level gzip/error_page overrides, server-level sub_filter, recursive error pages, proxy_intercept_errors. Round-3 closure (REQ-2026-0042): location-level gzip/error_page overrides, proxy_intercept_errors across http/server/location, recursive_error_pages (three-hop bound), and server-level sub_filter are runtime-executable; the regression covers all of it (66 cases). Remaining intentional differences: recursive chain bound, static-only error-page targets, RFC 8441, OCSP stapling, zero-downtime listener handoff.

Conditional requests, ranges and cache policy (2026-09, REQ-2026-0071): the data plane is now compared field by field against a real nginx binary (a 50-case battery under tests/nginx/differential, oracle baseline captured from nginx 1.29.6). Seven behavioural defects and two header-placement defects were closed: a missing `If-Match` precondition, `If-Modified-Since` not outranking `If-None-Match`, a 304 that dropped its validators, `If-Range` not gating the range, weak static ETags, `Accept-Ranges` on a 206, validators attached to a 416, `expires modified <time>` failing to publish `Expires` on the stale branch, and `@24h` normalising a day too far ahead. The battery refuses to run against a stale gateway binary and proves which implementation answered on each port, because Windows localhost forwarding can route a connection into a WSL listener and make the comparison measure nginx against itself.

Cataloged context gap (2026-09): the nginx-compat `root`/`alias` validator requires a POSIX absolute path (`starts_with('/')` fails closed), so a Windows drive path such as `root D:/srv/www;` is rejected even though nginx on Windows accepts it. Every fixture renders drive paths into their drive-relative form (`posix_root`) to work around this. Aligning the validator with platform-native absolute paths has not been done.

capabilities.summary: [nginx].enabled (nginx.enabled) master switch for sidecar W16 and nginx.conf import activation
TOML→nginx.<profile>.conf render + W16 equivalence when nginx.enabled
Classify + draft IR + review TOML emit (--write-toml) with optional --validate; does not auto-overwrite deployments/webserver; include stays preserve-only
Streaming reverse proxy with bounded timeouts and safe retries
Classic HTTP/1.1 WebSocket tunnels
RFC 8441 extended CONNECT over HTTP/2
proxySetHeader executes with $host/$scheme/$remote_addr/$proxy_add_x_forwarded_for/$http_upgrade/$server_port; unsupported $vars fail closed at materialize (nginx.conf + TOML)

Response gzip via CompressionLayer (gzipTypes + gzipMinLength + text/html); server-level gzip/gzip_types/gzip_min_length resolve a per-vhost policy with nginx inheritance (REQ-2026-0041); brotli remains out of this capability id
proxy_cache subset: GET/HEAD memory+disk L1/L2, Cache-Control freshness, Vary keys, single-flight, stale-on-5xx window (proxy_cache_use_stale)

expires (off/epoch/max/<time>/modified <time>/@<time>, signed, ngx_parse_time units) + etag on|off + if_modified_since exact|before|off resolve a per-route/per-host CachePolicyConfig with independent nginx http->server->location inheritance on both planes (nginx.conf and typed TOML location keys); the data plane rewrites Expires/Cache-Control at the response choke point for nginx's ten safe status codes, suppresses static ETag generation for `etag off`, and honors the exact|before|off If-Modified-Since comparison. Known difference: the daily `@<time>` form is evaluated in UTC (nginx uses the server local time zone; identical with TZ=UTC, which the deployment image pins). Conditional requests were aligned against real nginx 1.29.6 through a 50-case differential battery (tests/nginx/differential, REQ-2026-0071): `If-Match` answers 412 on a miss, `If-Modified-Since` votes before `If-None-Match`, a 304 keeps ETag/Last-Modified/Cache-Control while clearing Content-Type/Length/Accept-Ranges, `If-Range` gates the Range so a stale validator serves the whole representation instead of a 206, `Accept-Ranges` never appears on a partial response, and an unsatisfiable range keeps only `Content-Range` and drops the representation validators. Static ETags are strong (`"<mtime>-<size>"`) rather than weak, which nginx-compatible `If-Range` byte equality requires.
limit_req_zone + limit_req (burst/nodelay; delay queue not scheduled) for $binary_remote_addr/$remote_addr
Location allow then deny ACL; unmatched with rules present denies (nginx access module)
auth_basic + auth_basic_user_file (htpasswd $apr1$/{SHA}/bcrypt); 401 WWW-Authenticate challenge
Exact (=) and prefix (/ and ^~) location matching; ^~ materializes as prefix-exclusive (suppresses regex)
PCRE-like ~ / ~* locations via Rust regex crate; nginx selection order with ^~ prefix-exclusive
rewrite subset last/break/redirect/permanent with $1..$n captures and bounded internal redirects

OCSP stapling is not implemented. Commercial impact is bounded: Let's Encrypt ended OCSP service (2025) and the declared fleet uses short-lived ACME certificates, nginx defaults ssl_stapling off, and rustls (0.23) supports the ocsp field only for TLS 1.2-style stapling with no refresh task. Declarations are now reported as accepted-but-unenforced instead of silently ignored (server_toml typed diagnostics + nginx-conf import diagnostics); implementation requires an OCSP fetch/refresh/verification owner and is not part of the declared commercial profile

Indexed real-nginx differential slices under tests/nginx/: conditional-cache (50 cases, tools/run-nginx-differential.mjs, captured nginx 1.29.6 oracle), broad HTTP surface (75 cases, tools/run-nginx-differential-http.mjs), virtual-host selection + named locations (39 cases, tools/run-nginx-differential-host.mjs), plus the in-process full-surface behavioural corpus (76 cases, tools/run-nginx-behavioral-corpus.mjs). tools/run-nginx-compat-gate.mjs executes them all as the release gate. Oracles are committed and pinned; a real nginx binary is needed only to refresh them. Full OSS parity remains out of profile

Strategy-pattern config sources (nginx conf / TOML / JSON) behind one ConfigSource trait + WebServerConfigLoader with auto-detection and --format override; single-file TOML mode; parity regression corpus (tests/config_sources.rs)

error_page http/server/location mappings with nginx replace-on-declare inheritance; generated static errors (including ACL 403), proxy_intercept_errors-mapped upstream errors, Respond/Redirect statuses and rewrite-generated redirects internally redirect to the target with optional =code status replacement; targets are static paths or bounded @named locations (one internal redirect); recursive_error_pages chains are bounded to three hops (REQ-2026-0042, REQ-2026-0073)

sub_filter / sub_filter_once / sub_filter_types / sub_filter_last_modified response body substitution at http/server/location with replace-on-declare inheritance, ordered before gzip like nginx filters (REQ-2026-0042)
limit_conn_zone / limit_conn per-key concurrent connection limiting with request-lifetime leases (503 on exceed)
secure_link_secret URI rewrites and secure_link/secure_link_md5/secure_link_expires query digests (403 on invalid/expired)
Variable proxy_pass templates (http://$host, $server_port, $uri, $request_uri, $http_<name>) evaluated per request; SSRF guard authorizes restricted networks with hard-forbidden ranges blocked
proxy_pass_request_headers off strips client request headers upstream (fixed safe defaults still applied)

nginx server_name forms: exact, leading wildcard of any depth (longest wins), trailing wildcard (longest), .suffix (claims bare + wildcard), ~ regex in authored order with nginx case folding, and listener default fallback; duplicate ownership fails closed. TLS SNI stays exact plus one-level wildcard, so regex/trailing-wildcard names on ssl listeners fail closed. Evidence: core/server_name.rs + tests/server_name_selection.rs and tests/nginx/differential-host (39 cases)

Bounded named locations (location @name) as try_files … @name / error_page … = @name targets with exactly one internal redirect, compile-time rejection of chains/cycles, request-path unreachability, and nginx-faithful phase order (gates re-applied; named return short-circuits before access; header filters on the final response)

Directive-level http-core-v1 contract: specs/nginx-directive-inventory.json (744 nginx 1.29.6 OSS directives from ngx_command_t tables), specs/nginx-directive-support.catalog.json (executable / accepted-unenforced / fail-closed / excluded with runtime field, evidence, risk, migration action), generated operator matrix docs/guides/operator/NGINX-COMPATIBILITY-MATRIX.md, and the offline drift gate tools/check-nginx-directive-matrix.mjs (11 checks)

tools/run-nginx-compat-gate.mjs wired into _sdkwork:verify as check:nginx-compat: runs the gap catalog, corpus manifest, directive matrix, in-process behavioural corpus and every manifest-indexed differential orchestrator with SDKWORK_REQUIRE_NGINX_EVIDENCE=1, so an unexecuted compatibility gate fails the release

Both configuration planes report accepted-but-unenforced behaviour: nginx-conf import emits one diagnostic per accepted-ignored directive (mapping::ignored_directive_diagnostics); typed TOML reports behaviour-affecting accepted keys via server_toml::UNENFORCED_BEHAVIOR_TOML_KEYS, surfaced in LoadedWebServerConfig.compatibility and printed by `validate` (compatibility: lines + acceptedButUnenforced count)

Multipart byte-range responses: a multi-range request answers 206 multipart/byteranges with nginx-exact framing and 20-digit boundary (previously 416); unsatisfiable/invalid single ranges still answer 416 with nginx headers (REQ-2026-0073 differential-http)

proxy_pass URI-part splice is nginx-exact: the matched location prefix is replaced by the proxy_pass URI without inserting a slash (/d + /v1/ -> /v1//inner for prefix locations, exact location keeps /v1/), proven against nginx 1.29.6

nginx add_header semantics at http/server/location: a level that declares any add_header replaces the inherited array; authored order and duplicate names preserved; the nginx default status list (200,201,204,206,301,302,303,304,307,308) gates emission unless `always`; bounded $var expansion ($host/$scheme/$remote_addr/$server_port/$request_uri/$uri/$document_uri/$args/$is_args/$request_method/$server_name); unknown variables, non-ASCII and oversize declarations fail closed. Applied at one choke point on every response kind (static, proxy, cache, Respond/Redirect, rewrite redirects, error pages, named-location hops, generated and access-control rejections). nginx-materialized hosts no longer promote headers into the unconditional dedicated security fields; an explicit nosniff declaration is status-gated like nginx
A directory request with no index file answers 403 (nginx autoindex-off) without an ETag, and does not fall through to the SPA fallback; differential case static.dir-no-index against nginx 1.29.6

Bounded nginx map execution at http context: default/exact/hostnames wildcard/ordered regex keys with $0-$9 captures, empty-result omission, result variables usable in add_header/proxy_set_header/return URL+body/rewrite replacement/variable proxy_pass; supported source vocabulary is the 11 fixed variables plus $http_/$arg_/$cookie_ families; unsupported sources/values/volatile/duplicate results fail closed with located diagnostics (REQ-2026-0073 wave 1, differential-http maps.* cases vs nginx 1.29.6)

nginx types + default_type: replace-on-declare MIME table and independently inherited default_type at http/server/location; static responses and return bodies resolve Content-Type from the configured table, unknown extension uses default_type, 204 omits Content-Type; typed TOML [http] defaultType + ordered [[http.mimeTypes]] materialized (REQ-2026-0073 wave 1)

gzip_static off|on|always: precompressed <path>.gz sidecars served inside the approved static root (symlink/.. safe) with nginx-exact sidecar Content-Length/ETag/Last-Modified, original-path Content-Type, Content-Encoding gzip, range/HEAD/304 behavior, q=0 and identity fallback, and always-mode without Vary; orphan sidecars and gunzip remain documented gaps (REQ-2026-0073 wave 1)

gzip_vary on|off at http/server/location: nginx default off, and the runtime strips tower-http's automatic Vary: Accept-Encoding when the policy is off; sidecar/negotiated responses follow the policy (REQ-2026-0073 wave 1)

nginx redirect construction policies at http/server/location: absolute_redirect (off -> relative Location), port_in_redirect (omit scheme-default port), server_name_in_redirect (first server_name instead of request Host); one handler choke point covers static directory redirects, return 3xx /path, rewrite redirect/permanent and error_page-mapped 3xx, proven byte-for-byte against nginx 1.29.6 (REQ-2026-0073 wave 2)
limit_req_status / limit_conn_status: configurable 400-599 rejection status with http->server->location inheritance (default 503), proven against nginx 1.29.6 (REQ-2026-0073 wave 2)

max_ranges n at http/server/location: 0 disables range processing (full 200, no Accept-Ranges) and a ceiling declines over-limit multi-range requests to a full 200 with Accept-Ranges, matching nginx range-filter behaviour (REQ-2026-0073 wave 2)

Typed TOML certificate chainFile is consumed end-to-end: validated, resolved to a readable file, decoded and appended to the served certificate chain (DER-deduped, fail-closed on empty/malformed PEM); previously the key was silently dropped (REQ-2026-0073 wave 2)

Typed TOML [[http.maps]] materializes ordered map definitions (source/result/hostnames/default/entries) into WebServerAppConfig.maps with the same validation as the nginx-conf plane; the legacy string-array map key remains accepted-unenforced with a located diagnostic pointing at [[http.maps]] (REQ-2026-0073 wave 2)

proxyConnectTimeout / proxyReadTimeout / proxySendTimeout are advertised in the location supported-key list but not consumed; they now emit located accepted-unenforced diagnostics instead of being silently dropped (REQ-2026-0073 wave 2)

proxy_hide_header / proxy_pass_header / proxy_redirect / proxy_cookie_path / proxy_cookie_domain execute nginx response-header policy: pinned default-hidden set (Date, Server, X-Pad, X-Accel-*), pass-list wins on conflict, Location/Refresh rewriting for off|default|explicit from/to, Set-Cookie Path/Domain rewriting with attribute preservation, replace-on-declare inheritance; regex and $variable forms fail closed. 18 real-nginx differential cases (REQ-2026-0073 wave 2b)

nginx `internal` locations: parsed at location context, unreachable by external request (nginx-style 404 with the location's add_header and host error_page mapping intact), reachable via rewrite last / error_page / named targets; http/server contexts still fail closed (REQ-2026-0073 wave 2b)

merge_slashes on|off resolves per host; off keeps repeated slashes in the canonical path for exact-location identity, $uri, %2F decoding, alias/static resolution and dot-segment handling, matching nginx in both modes; the nginx pre-vhost-selection quirk is documented as a bounded divergence (REQ-2026-0073 wave 2b)

underscores_in_headers / ignore_invalid_headers: per-host request-header acceptance policy; nginx-plane default drops underscore headers before all modules, typed TOML keeps its historical permissive default, and the runtime HTTP boundary always rejects non-token header names with 400 (documented stricter divergence) (REQ-2026-0073 wave 2b)
